End the run script here when the scenario is fake

Source: R/use_scenario.R
end_if_fake_scenario.Rd

end_if_fake_scenario() ends a run script after save_results() when the scenario is not "real". The part of the script after it is for the real data only, for example the figures.

Usage

end_if_fake_scenario()

Value

Invisibly, NULL, when the scenario is "real".

Details

Call it directly after save_results() in vNN_run.R. It reads the scenario that the last initialize_project() call set:

  • For "real", it does nothing, and the script continues.

  • For a fake scenario in a non-interactive R session, for example under Rscript or run_scenarios(), it quits R with status 0. No line after it runs.

  • For a fake scenario in an interactive R session, it stops with an error of class pbn_end_if_fake_scenario. The R session stays open.

It stops with an error when no initialize_project() call set a scenario in this R session.

See also

Other project setup: initialize_project(), run_scenarios(), use_scenario()

Examples

home <- file.path(tempdir(), "pbn_end_example")
dir.create(file.path(home, "v01_functions"), recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(home, "data"))
writeLines(
  "CFG <- list(scenarios = data.frame(scenario = 'real', sims = 1))",
  file.path(home, "v01_functions", "_cfg.R")
)
pbn::initialize_project("v01", home, file.path(home, "data"), env = new.env())
#> You are NOT sourcing into .GlobalEnv. All functions will be sourced into an environment that is returned from this function.
#> Sourcing all code inside /tmp/RtmpbNfz7k/pbn_end_example/v01_functions into 
pbn::end_if_fake_scenario()

unlink(home, recursive = TRUE)
